flows.title: Commercial Food Establishment Operating License & Plan Review
flows.description: Procedural verification for opening a restaurant, café, commercial kitchen, or food market in Edison Township under Chapter 24 NJ State Sanitary Code.

check_cfpm_certification.title: Step 1 of 3: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
check_cfpm_certification.message: Under New Jersey Sanitary Code (N.J.A.C. 8:24), retail food facilities must designate an active Certified Food Protection Manager (ServSafe or ANSI-accredited credential). Does your establishment have a certified manager on staff?
check_cfpm_certification.help_text: Certificate copy must be appended to the official application.

options.label: Yes, Active CFPM Certificate on File
options.description: ServSafe or ANSI accredited manager certificate active

options.label: No / Certification Not Yet Completed
options.description: Manager has not taken or passed accredited exam

disqualify_no_cfpm.title: Mandatory Prerequisite: Certified Food Manager Required
disqualify_no_cfpm.message: Public health statutes prohibit issuing food establishment licenses without verified food safety management credentials on staff.
disqualify_no_cfpm.alternative_action: Enroll in an accredited 8-hour ServSafe examination course. Once passing score is received, return to complete this licensing procedure.

check_grease_interceptor.title: Step 2 of 3: Commercial Kitchen Grease Trap & Plumbing
check_grease_interceptor.message: Will your facility prepare, cook, fry, or reheat warm foods producing fats, oils, or grease (FOG)? If yes, an approved automatic grease interceptor (grease trap) sized per plumbing code is mandatory.

options.label: Yes, Grease Trap Installed & Servicing Contract Active
options.description: Compliant interceptor plumbed to three-compartment sink

options.label: No, Pre-Packaged / Cold-Beverage Only (No Cooking / No FOG)
options.description: Coffee bar, packaged smoothie, or dry baked goods only

issue_form_hlt_plan.title: Prerequisites Satisfied: Official Form Issuance
issue_form_hlt_plan.message: Healthcare licensing prerequisites satisfied! Download the official Edison Health Department Plan Review Application below and submit to the Edison Township Health Department.
issue_form_hlt_plan.form_title: Edison Township Retail Food Establishment Plan Review Application
issue_form_hlt_plan.fill_in_instructions:
1. Complete establishment details and owner contact.
2. Detail proposed menu items and kitchen equipment schedule.
3. Attach floor plan showing 3-compartment sink and handwash stations.
4. Submit with review fee to Edison Health Department.
required_attachments: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) certificate copy
Menu Copy with Allergen Disclosure Statements

fee_info.payment_methods: Check payable to 'Township of Edison' or in person at Municipal Complex

submission_routing.department: Edison Department of Health and Human Services

issue_form_hlt_plan.lead_time: 10 to 15 Business Days prior to pre-opening inspection
